seasons.label: Archery
seasons.notes: General deer & elk archery. Backcountry HDs 150, 280, 316 differ (Sep 5-14; HD 316 has no archery-only season).

seasons.label: General (rifle)

seasons.label: Spring
seasons.notes: Spring black bear. Certain BMUs (e.g. 300, 301, 319, 580) may close early after May 31 if female-harvest threshold reached.

seasons.bag_limit_summary: 7 ducks/mergansers daily; max 2 hen mallards, 3 pintail, 2 redheads, 2 canvasbacks, 2 scaup
seasons.notes: Regular season Oct 3-Dec 27 (scaup closes Dec 27); ducks excluding scaup continue Dec 28-Jan 15, 2027. Youth days Sep 26-27.

seasons.bag_limit_summary: 6 ducks/mergansers daily; max 5 mallards (2 hens), 3 wood ducks, 3 pintail, 2 canvasbacks, 1 scaup; +2 blue-winged teal Oct 3-11
seasons.notes: Zone 1 = northeastern/central counties (Blaine, Valley, Phillips, Fergus, etc.). Youth days Sep 26-27.

seasons.bag_limit_summary: 6 ducks/mergansers daily; max 5 mallards (2 hens), 3 wood ducks, 3 pintail, 2 canvasbacks, 1 scaup; +2 blue-winged teal Oct 3-11
seasons.notes: SPLIT: open Oct 3-11, closed, reopens Oct 24-Jan 19, 2027. Zone 2 = south-central counties (Yellowstone, Big Horn, Carbon, etc.). Youth days Sep 26-27.
